attribute.name: IS_ServersCheckInterval
attribute.description: Defines time interval (in seconds) to check new IS servers

relationship.name: Subscriptions
relationship.description: Defines subscription criteria for the application

attribute.name: CachePath
attribute.description: Cache directory to store downsampled files

attribute.name: CacheMaxSize
attribute.description: Maximum size of merging data files per group in xC format, where x is an integer and C is one of m,g (megabytes, gigabytes). If not set, the size is unlimited.

attribute.name: DownsampleThreadsPoolSize
attribute.description: Number of threads processing downsampling requests

attribute.name: EOSRepositoryDirectory
attribute.description: Name of directory to store links on P-BEAST data processed by Castor script.

attribute.name: SleepInterval
attribute.description: Sleep interval between checks of new files (in seconds)

attribute.name: DataSplitDuration
attribute.description: Data split duration in xC format, where x is an integer and C is one of h,d,w (hours, days, weeks)

attribute.name: DataGroupMaxSize
attribute.description: Maximum size of RAM used for merging data per group of files in xC format, where x is an integer and C is one of m,g (megabytes, gigabytes)

attribute.name: MaxReceiverDelay
attribute.description: Maximum delay of data introduced by receiver (in hours)

attribute.name: DiskBalanceThreshold
attribute.description: Balance disks of repository servers used for merged data, when difference of occupancies exceeds this threshold (in percents)

class.name: PBeastReceiverApplication
class.description: Describes common properties of P-BEAST receiver application.

attribute.name: RepositoryDirName
attribute.description: Name of directory containing pBeast data.

attribute.name: MaxSaveDelay
attribute.description: Save data after given time interval (in seconds)

attribute.name: MaxDataSize
attribute.description: Total maximum size of data buckets for all attributes. High values are more efficient but require more RAM.

attribute.name: MaxFileSize
attribute.description: Defines maximum number of data points per single file (the maximum size of data buckets for single attribute).

attribute.name: MaxDataDelay
attribute.description: Max delay of unordered data (in seconds). Commit data older this parameter. Maynot be greater than MaxSaveDelay parameter.

attribute.name: FlushDataThreshold
attribute.description: Define amount of data (in percents) to be flushed, when MaxDataSize limit reached. Small value results more frequent flush operations creating smaller number of new files each time.

attribute.name: SaveCheckInterval
attribute.description: Define frequency of save checks

class.name: PBeastRepositoryApplication
class.description: Describes P-BEAST repository application. Such application provides CORBA access to local and merged repositories and performs merging of files.

attribute.name: LocalRepositoryPath
attribute.description: Name of directory containing fresh P-BEAST data produced by P-BEAST receivers. May not be empty, if merger service is active.

attribute.name: RepositoryPath
attribute.description: Name of directory to store merged P-BEAST data.

attribute.name: PublishLocalRepositoryInfo
attribute.description: Publish monitoring information about local repository.

attribute.name: PublishRepositoryInfo
attribute.description: Publish monitoring information about merged repository.

attribute.name: MaxResponseSize
attribute.description: Limit response size per user request in xC format, where x is an integer and C is one of m,g (megabytes, gigabytes). Maximum supported value is 2g (omniORB limit).

attribute.name: MaxLocalDsDataSize
attribute.description: Limit size of local data read by downsampling request in xC format, where x is an integer and C is one of m,g (megabytes, gigabytes).

attribute.name: SeriesInfoMaxSize
attribute.description: Maximum size of RAM used for in-memory cache of series info in xC format, where x is an integer and C is one of m,g (megabytes, gigabytes)

relationship.name: MergerConfiguration
relationship.description: Defines the merger configuration. If not set, the merger service is not active.

relationship.name: DownsampleCacheConfig
relationship.description: Defines compaction parameters used for downsampled files in cache directory. If not set, the downsample cache is not used.

attribute.name: ReadWhenSubscribe
attribute.description: Read data from server, when subscribe on it

attribute.name: Servers
attribute.description: Names of IS servers. Subscribe all, if empty.

attribute.name: InfoNames
attribute.description: Put mask for IS info names. Subscribe all, if empty.

relationship.name: Types
relationship.description: If set, subscribe or exclude given type [and derived]. If not set, subscribe all types.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.description: Name of IS class

attribute.name: CriteriaLogic
attribute.description: This logic is used, when both subscriptions by names ans types are used

attribute.name: HttpPort
attribute.description: HTTP port

attribute.name: HttpThreadPoolSize
attribute.description: HTTP thread pool size

attribute.name: HttpTimeout
attribute.description: HTTP timeout

class.name: PBeastZipConfig
class.description: Describes how to compress P-BEAST files

attribute.name: ZipCatalog
attribute.description: Zip catalog of object names

attribute.name: ZipIntegerTypeData
attribute.description: Zip integer type data (bool,u8,s8,u16,s16,u32,s32,u64,s64)

attribute.name: ZipFloatingPointTypeData
attribute.description: Zip floating-point type data (float,double)

attribute.name: ZipVoidData
attribute.description: Zip void data (end-of-validity, update-info)

attribute.name: ZipStringTypeData
attribute.description: Zip string type data

attribute.name: CatalogizeStringsData
attribute.description: Catalogize string data
